checks.name: SBOM Policy Enforcement
checks.fix: No SscaEnforcement step found in the pipeline. The pipeline generates an SBOM via SscaOrchestration (RAISE Gate 2) but never enforces it against an allow/deny list. Fix: Add an SscaEnforcement step in the Supply_Chain step group immediately after RAISE_Gate_2_SBOM_Generation. Policy: sbom_policy_enforcement.rego

checks.name: IaC Scanning
checks.fix: No IaC stages detected in this pipeline. Marked N/A.

checks.name: OPA Policy Set (On Run)
checks.fix: Two OPA Policy Sets exist (RAISE_2_0_Pipeline_Governance, RAISE_CVE_Zero_Tolerance), but neither has action=onrun. RAISE_2_0_Pipeline_Governance is onsave; RAISE_CVE_Zero_Tolerance is onstepstart. Fix: Add a new Policy Set or update RAISE_CVE_Zero_Tolerance to also trigger on onrun with Error+Exit enforcement so CVE-blocking fires at pipeline run time. Policy: opa_onrun_policy.rego

checks.name: Severity Thresholds
checks.fix: STO scanner steps (Gitleaks, Semgrep, Owasp, OsvScanner, AquaTrivy, Zap) are all missing spec.advanced.fail_on_severity. Every scanner step has failureStrategies: Ignore which means critical findings will NEVER block the pipeline. Fix: Set spec.advanced.fail_on_severity: critical on each STO step and remove the blanket Ignore failure strategies (or scope them to specific non-security errors only). Policy: severity_thresholds.rego

checks.name: Build Tool Chain Integrity
checks.fix: Two Tier-1 build steps use floating image references. (1) Application_Build step uses node:20-alpine — no digest pin. (2) RAISE_Gate_8_Push_to_Registry (BuildAndPushDockerRegistry) uses the Harness default builder with no explicit pinned builderImage. SolarWinds-class risk: a compromised registry tag can inject malicious code that no downstream scanner will detect because the source code was never touched. Fix: Pin Application_Build to node:20-alpine@sha256:<digest> and explicitly set builderImage: <img>@sha256:<digest> on the BuildAndPushDockerRegistry step. Policy: build_tool_integrity.rego
